description:
SUDUM is an interactive documentary experience exploring the stories of NASA’s space missions and the equipment left behind on Mars and the Moon.

Through authentic imagery, verified scientific information, and interactive storytelling, the project highlights the discoveries and lasting legacy of space exploration.

Every mission ends, but its story remains.
summary: SUDUM is a bilingual interactive web experience that brings the stories of NASA’s exploration vehicles left on the Moon and Mars to life. Through cinematic visuals, interactive exploration, and engaging storytelling, users can discover the journeys of the Opportunity and Spirit rovers and the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle. The project transforms historical mission information into an accessible digital experience that connects audiences with the technology, challenges, and achievements behind space exploration. By combining verified NASA resources with creative visual storytelling, SUDUM aims to preserve these missions’ stories, inspire curiosity, and make space history more engaging for everyone.
details:
SUDUM is a bilingual interactive web experience that brings the stories of NASA’s exploration vehicles left on the Moon and Mars to life. It features the Opportunity and Spirit rovers, along with the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle, through cinematic visual environments and first-person written storytelling that allows each vehicle to narrate its journey through on-screen captions.
Users can explore mission timelines, discover significant scientific milestones, interact with visual experiences, and test their knowledge through quizzes. By combining verified NASA mission information with creative digital storytelling, SUDUM transforms historical space exploration missions into an accessible and engaging educational experience for Arabic and English-speaking audiences.
The project aims to preserve the stories of these historic vehicles, inspire curiosity about space exploration, and help audiences connect with the discoveries and challenges behind each mission.
